confusion_check.shared_appearances: Plain documents overlap with legacy pages and reduction; bright outlined UI overlaps with Memphis-like graphics.
confusion_check.discriminating_relationships: Gumroad organizes a neobrutalist interface through heavy functional boundaries and flat color fields; the Copeland page uses a direct document hierarchy, exposed links and restrained chrome. These are distinct branches, not one mandatory recipe. A historical plain website or reduced palette alone does not establish deliberate Web Brutalism.
confusion_check.cannot_conclude: The finding is limited to this recorded view/branch. This records the published 2025 viewport only. Heavy functional boundaries and flat fields are visible, but a recurring hard-shadow system or fixed 45-degree offset is not established in this screenshot. It does not establish Antidesign, whole-site behavior, accessibility or the current homepage.
